nodes.label: App Architecture (Three-Layer)
nodes.rationale: Layered architecture separates real-time audio backend (pluggable via ABC), tool system (per-personality), and robot motion (60Hz control loop). This allows swapping backends (HuggingFace/OpenAI/Gemini) without changing motion or tool code.

nodes.label: fastrtc (Low-latency Audio Streaming)
nodes.rationale: All backends use fastrtc for low-latency audio streaming, ensuring consistent real-time performance regardless of which AI backend is chosen.

nodes.label: MovementManager (moves.py)
nodes.rationale: Runs at ~60Hz on a dedicated worker thread, blending primary (mutually exclusive) and secondary (additive) moves. This separation allows simultaneous speech-reactive wobble and head-tracking without conflicting with dance/emotion states.

nodes.label: SmolVLM2 Local Vision Model
nodes.rationale: SmolVLM2 is offered as a separate optional extra for on-device VLM inference, enabling privacy-preserving local vision without cloud round-trips. Not supported on Raspberry Pi due to compute constraints.

nodes.label: Personality / Profile System
nodes.rationale: Profiles encapsulate instructions.txt, tools.txt, and optional voice.txt per personality, loaded via config.py from .env. This allows non-code customization of robot behavior and external profiles via env vars.

nodes.label: AI-Generated Code Policy
nodes.rationale: AI-assisted contributions are allowed but require human review, minimal code, human-written PR responses, and avoidance of bulk changes. Low-quality auto-generated PRs will be closed to protect the small maintainer team.

nodes.label: Hugging Face Space Mirror (CI)
nodes.rationale: Tagged releases are auto-synced to HuggingFace Spaces via GitHub Actions. PR branches get private preview Spaces automatically, removing need for manual HF hub interaction.

nodes.label: Locked Profile Mode
nodes.rationale: Setting LOCKED_PROFILE constant in config.py prevents runtime profile switching, useful for dedicated robot clones with a fixed personality.

nodes.label: External Profiles and Tools System
nodes.rationale: External profiles/tools outside the repo can be mounted via env vars (REACHY_MINI_EXTERNAL_PROFILES_DIRECTORY, REACHY_MINI_EXTERNAL_TOOLS_DIRECTORY), supporting both downloaded tools with built-in profiles and downloaded profiles with built-in tools.
